people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

translations.web: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was assembled as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba, with the land of Gilead, to Yahweh at Mizpah.
translations.bsb: Then all the Israelites from Dan to Beersheba and from the land of Gilead came out, and the congregation assembled as one man before the LORD at Mizpah.
translations.kjv: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba, with the land of Gilead, unto the LORD in Mizpeh.
translations.asv: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was assembled as one man, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, with the land of Gilead, unto Jehovah at Mizpah.
